items.title: Awesome Neovim
items.content_text:
### Colorscheme / Assembly

*   [samesense/savitsky.nvim (⭐7)](https://github.com/samesense/savitsky.nvim) - ***`[TS][LSP][L/D][Lua]`*** Curated color palettes inspired by paintings from the Savitsky Museum, built on top of `catppuccin`.

### Git / Quickfix

*   [Sengoku11/commitpad.nvim (⭐6)](https://github.com/Sengoku11/commitpad.nvim) - Write informative commits with persistent worktree-isolated drafts, visual 50/72 guides, and a Markdown buffer.

### Session / Indent

*   [Akmadan23/local-session.nvim (⭐5)](https://github.com/Akmadan23/local-session.nvim) - A fast, minimal and implicit current-working-directory-based session manager with easy to configure session files in Lua.

### UI / OS-specific

*   [jrop/tuis.nvim (⭐113)](https://github.com/jrop/tuis.nvim) - A collection of interactive TUIs which provides rich, interactive UIs to various CLIs.
